evidence.limits: No transcript yet; speech is coded from burned-in captions (4 fps for the hook, 1 fps afterwards so some caption words between 5 and 56 s are missed). Sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Excerpt of his book 'לשרוף את הספינות' (audiobook): you die suddenly and your time is up; you have all the time in the world to sleep later; wake up and do what you want in the time you have.
audience: His followers and general Hebrew viewers who feel they are postponing life; aspiring achievers.
caption_vs_video_note: Matches in theme; the caption also says the audiobook is free on his YouTube channel (a pointer not shown in the video) and ends with a birthday and mortality question not in the video. Matan never appears on camera.

opening.first_frame: Motorcycle handlebar POV at a junction, pickup truck approaching; white caption 'ואז -' mid-frame.
opening.s0_1: Same shot, a pickup approaches from the distance; caption 'ואז -' held for about 1 s; the truck hits a vehicle at about 1.0 s.
opening.s1_3: Debris flies (1.0-1.5 s), then at about 1.7 s a hard cut to black; red caption 'אתה מת.' from 2.25 s to about 3.0 s.
opening.s3_5: Cut to a framed film clip of a young man in a plaid shirt with a snowy mountain behind him: captions 'לפתע' (3.0), 'בדיוק רגע' (3.75), 'לפני שהגעת' (4.25), then 'לפסגת ההר' (5.0).
opening.visual_hook: A shocking real-looking crash in first-person view on a motorbike, then a black screen.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s (machine transcript): 'ואז... אתה מת.' (0 to 2.7 s), a voiceover reading second-person narration that matches the captions; 'לפתע. בדיוק רגע לפני שהגעת לפסגת ההר' follows at 3 s.
opening.first_sentence_standalone: no: it starts with 'ואז -' (and then), a mid-thought start that is solved by the sudden death shown
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions carry every line, the crash is visual.

visual.subject_placement: After the first 1.7 s every clip sits inside a rounded old-TV frame (about 40 percent of the height) in the middle of a black field; captions at the bottom of that frame, around 55 to 60 percent down.
visual.setting: Film and TV clips: mountain top, cemetery, gym of a dying man, TV set, office, diner, bus, rainy funeral, church funeral, city lights at night, a hospital bed, a stage, drums, a trading floor.
visual.lighting: Each clip keeps its own grade; the frame darkens the edges.
visual.color_contrast: Black field, white captions with red and lime emphasis words; clips are saturated and varied.
visual.props_and_gestures: Not Matan; film actors: arms spread on a mountain, a man at a gravestone, a man in an open coffin scene, a hospital smile, a stage speech.
visual.supporting_footage: A first-person motorbike crash clip (viral-style) at 0-1.7 s, then about 40 film or TV clips, one per phrase.
visual.visual_progression: 0-1.7 crash POV; 1.7-3 black with red 'אתה מת.'; 3-6 mountain clip; 6 black 'נגמר לך הזמן.'; 7-12 swirling colour, birds at sunset, cemetery; 12-20 face close-ups, light flare, a TV-studio clip; 20-26 office and diner clips; 27-33 rain funeral and a mourner; 33-36 church funeral; 35-37 night city; 37-39 an eye close-up; 40-47 more clips; 48-56 celebration, stairs dance, starry sky, drums, stage speaker.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the red 'אתה מת.' title card from about 2.25 s.
visual.ui_interference: Captions stay mid-lower frame (about 55-60 percent down), clear of the bottom 35 percent zone only partly; the lower edge of captions is at about 62 percent.

editing.edit_function: ffmpeg found only 3 hard cuts because the dark frame hides the others; there are about 40 clip changes by eye (every 1 to 3 s), each matched to a phrase: stimulation and illustration of the narration. Black title cards ('אתה מת.', 'נגמר לך הזמן.') are emotional beats.
pacing_changes: t=0-6 s: fast, ends on two black text cards
t=7-47 s: a steady clip every 1 to 3 s
t=48-56 s: speed up, with lime and red emphasis on the last lines
editing.ending: Last 3 s: a stage speaker with open arms, captions 'כל מה שאנחנו רוצים בתוך הזמן הזה!' (lime on the last words); no end card.
editing.loop: partial: the last line is about time, and the start is the death of the motorcyclist, so the cover line 'אתה מת.' follows from the end by theme.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: emotional, quotable lines and film moments; commenters call it a 'slap in the face' and a daily reminder.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript shows a continuous narration from 0 to about 57 s in 1 to 4 s lines, an even pace with a short pause at 2.7 to 3 s (matches the black card); no long gaps. Ends 'אנחנו יכולים להיות כל מה שאנחנו רוצים בתוך הזמן הזה'.
sound.music: unclear (the transcript shows no lyrics; narration fills the track)
sound.sfx: inferred: a crash sound at about 1 s is likely from the clip image, not confirmed
sound.sync: Captions follow the narration phrase by phrase; confirmed against the machine transcript. The 'נגמר לך הזמן' card matches the line at 5.8 s.

text.colour_coding: White default; red for dark or warning words ('אתה מת.', 'נגמר לך הזמן.', 'לא עומד להתעורר', 'בארון קבורה', 'מבלי לשים לב!'); lime green for positive or key words ('ככל שתרצה', 'חזק', 'חכם', 'הטובות ביותר שלך', 'תיקח את הסיכון').
text.placement: Bottom of the framed clip, centred; first black cards are centred on the full frame.
text.style: Medium-weight white sans-serif without a box; emphasis words coloured.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 5 words per card, one to two seconds each; about 100 words over 57 s.
text.language: Second person singular, plain; sharp lines: 'נגמר לך הזמן.', 'אנחנו לא כאן לנצח!', 'יש לנו דדליין'.
text.caption_structure: First line repeats the video hook ('ואז.. אתה מת ⚰️') with a prompt to take a minute to recall; source (book 'לשרוף את הספינות') and the free audiobook on YouTube; then a birthday statement and a question about not ending life today. Emojis, no hashtags; caption edited.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew punctuation: the dash in 'ואז -' renders to the left of the word; the ellipsis in 'שאנחנו רוצים...' appears on the left; quotes in the caption use Hebrew quote marks.

story.setup: A sudden death is shown, then 'you die' as the statement.
story.stakes: Time runs out without warning; you may never reach the summit or notice what you gave to others.
story.progression: Death, time over, 'you have all the time in the world to sleep later', cemetery and funerals, a series of questions ('was it all a dream?'), 'we are not here forever', 'we have a deadline'.
story.payoff: Resolution as a command: take the risk, do what you want in this time.
story.resolution: Closing line about all we want within this time.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: it ends on an explicit exhortation tied to the opening death
friction_points: t=1.7-3 s: black screen right after the crash (interpretation: may cost viewers who expected the crash story)
t=27-33 s: a funeral run of 6 s with six-word lines (interpretation: slower and heavier)

explicit_prompts.wording: קחו דקה כדי להיזכר (implicit); free audiobook on YouTube

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 45, not representative. Mostly praise ('שמת לי סטירה לפנים', 'בוקס בבטן'); some criticism: the crash clip upsets motorbike riders, one says the final question sounds suicidal ('נשמע אובדני'), another says thinking of death all the time means being broken (18 likes, the most liked); questions about the quote's source and a movie.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Emoji replies and one factual answer ('מהספר שלי').

conversion.benefit: Hear the rest of the book at no cost.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Caption mentions the free audiobook on YouTube; no link or on-screen pointer in the video.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the video is an excerpt from that book.
conversion.destination: YouTube channel (named, not linked); a commenter asked for the source, so the on-video source is not obvious.

rights_and_privacy: Third-party viral crash footage and about 40 film or TV clips throughout (yes); no bystanders of his own. LumeBook cannot copy the clips; the narrated-excerpt-over-clips format is replicable only with owned or licensed footage.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a shock opening, then a rapid chain of recognisable film moments that illustrate each line, with high-contrast red and lime emphasis words; the message is universal (time is limited) and the pace never lets a caption stay long. Shares per 1k views are 2.7.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the dark subject divides some viewers (comments call it suicidal or upsetting to riders) and the book source is not on screen.

standout_moments.what: Crash in first person at 1.0 s followed by a black card with 'אתה מת.': the hook and the cover.
Second black card 'נגמר לך הזמן.' resets attention before the long clip run.
'אנחנו לא כאן לנצח!' in red over a smiling hospital patient, the emotional peak.
